summary: Of the 10 target municipalities (25,000+ pop, zero orgs in our census), 8 have confirmed basketball organizations with working evidence URLs: Kawartha Lakes (Lindsay Wildcats), Sault Ste. Marie (Elite 8 Basketball Academy), Norfolk County (Norfolk Youth Basketball Association), Halton Hills (3 orgs incl. Halton Hills Girls' Basketball Club), Whitchurch-Stouffville (4 multi-town academies incl. Toronto Hoopstars with a Stouffville address), Haldimand County (Haldimand Huskies), New Tecumseth (Little Hoopers Jr NBA + South Simcoe Basketball Club), and Innisfil (South Simcoe Basketball Club + 2 Facebook-only programs). Two target municipalities show a genuine, well-searched gap: Georgina (town's own sports directory has zero basketball entries despite dozens of other sports listed) and Quinte West (only adult/adaptive basketball found at CFB Trenton; no youth club based in Trenton itself, though Belleville ~10km away has several). Of the 22 mid-size sweep towns, 20 have confirmed organizations (many via county-wide associations like Northumberland Minor Basketball covering both Cobourg and Port Hope, and Upper Valley Basketball covering both Pembroke and Petawawa); Kenora and Espanola are genuine gaps — Kenora's own recreation-clubs directory lists no basketball among 7 other sport categories, and Espanola returned nothing across every search angle tried. Recommend a second pass on Georgina, Quinte West, Kenora, and Espanola via direct phone calls to municipal recreation departments or a Facebook-graph-search tool, since small-town clubs that exist ONLY as unlisted/private Facebook groups are the likely blind spot of a pure web-search methodology.
